**Finding: compliant (sits at/above the fallback).**

The only licence grant is § 4(c) (p0021), the licence-back of Contractor's Information incorporated into the Works:

- **Not revocable / not at-will terminable** — the grant is expressly *perpetual* and royalty-free, with no revocation trigger. Nowhere near the walk-away position.
- **Affiliates and contractors** — not named, but the express *"right to grant a sublicense"* lets us extend coverage to affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf unilaterally, which is better than the fallback's "affiliates on written notice." § 4(d) (p0022) reinforces this by letting us engage others to modify the delivered software without further payment.
- **Successor transfer** — the licence is silent, but § 10 (p0042) allows assignment with consent "which will not be unreasonably withheld," preserving an M&A path.

Residual gaps versus the preferred position are minor sub-elements only — the word "irrevocable" is absent (though "perpetual" plus the absence of any revocation right does the work), and there is no automatic successor-transfer carve-out. Per the playbook's classification rules these are noted rather than redlined, so no markup was proposed. Ownership questions in § 4(a)–(b) are left to the IP rule to avoid double-flagging.
